question: Can a bounded pitch reference based on the measured forward wheel tracks improve ramp entry over the same proprioceptive controller?

sensor.range_noise: ideal simulated first-return distance; independent noisy delayed proprioception
sensor.query: Estimated distance since capture plus front-axle offset plus 0.8 times the commanded speed; adjacent measured endpoints on each track are mandatory.

paired_trials.sole_treatment: Signed preview-minus-proprioceptive pitch correction multiplied by 0, +1 or -1
paired_trials.startup: 0.3 s stand then 0.3 s smooth ramp to target
paired_trials.primary_window: From actual front-wheel contact with ramp to 0.4 m of forward travel past ramp toe. Compare truth body pitch after removing operating point with physical ground tangent at body center. A stopped/failed/incomplete traversal fails.
paired_trials.pass: Each of six on/off ramp pairs advances the 0.4 m and improves primary RMSE, median paired improvement >=10%, correct sign for >=3 ticks before contact in every on ramp, on beats inverted median primary RMSE for each grade sign; velocity RMSE and joint torque RMS each no more than 5% worse in every on/off comparison including flat; no additional falls or torque-limit violations.
paired_trials.presentation: Fixed seed 8417, +4 and -4 degrees, off and on side by side, PNGs to GIF <=5000000 bytes each and MP4, from stored trajectories without integration.

execution: CPU single environment, serial physics/render/torch verification, one thread one CPU, systemd Nice=10 MemoryHigh=2GiB MemoryMax=3GiB MemorySwapMax=0 MemoryOOMGroup=yes, >=4GiB to start and >=2GiB in run; preserve every terminal failure and partial. No retry, replacement or continuation of trials.
